title: Dev Update: Stable Pixel Beta is live🎉
author: stable_pixel
selftext:
Hi all, just wanted to share an update on a tool I've been sharing in this sub for some time now: **Stable Pixel**

The community has been super supportive, and I’m hyped to tell you that it's live since today! If you want to learn more, head over to [Stable Pixel](https://www.stablepixel.app/)! You'll get 10 Credits for free to play around with.

Some screenshots regarding the features, just for reference:

[Prompting:  Emphasize details or give a general outline of what you'll want to create](https://preview.redd.it/b74fk22e43wd1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=2ee7ee065ce417bce0e6014ded782b07f632cffc)

[Pose Editor:  For character creation, you can define the exact pose before the artwork is created](https://preview.redd.it/sqq4sgkf43wd1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=8becc35858d7ea50003273784461dc45a616ca8b)

[Asset Generation: The tool is also able to generate regular \(game\) assets as well](https://preview.redd.it/eb7twnah43wd1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=182122fcc4454ca8b425346e5783435a22ab7236)

I’d love to hear your feedback :)

  
PS: As it came up a lot, I'm still working on the sprite sheet generation part of the tool. Once there's something presentable, I'll be sharing more details on that.

  
Lots of love
